evidence: The two abstracts have common authors, laboratory, altitudes and subject prebreathe and exposure durations. Subject DCS counts match with different denominators. Exact linkage is unavailable.

The 25,000-ft 60-min prebreathe profile agrees on 5/15 VGE and zero symptomatic outcomes. The larger later 30,000-ft profile does not establish a distinct cohort. The 2001 endpoint includes recompression criteria.
Subject profiles at 25,000 and 30,000 ft match scheduling. Participant-level linkage and 40,000-ft reuse are unverified. The 2001 report does not give these observer denominators.
